revised_reasoning: Range-construction final call: FOLD, HIGH confidence. Two independent reasons converge. FIRST: board-reading correction. Jc7s5d2h has one spade (7s); hero AsKs has two spades; hero is NOT on a flush draw, only a runner-runner backdoor (~4% to flush by river). My R1, GTO R1, and Opus tier-up all built the CALL case on a non-existent nut flush draw. Stripping that fictitious equity, hero has at best 6 overcard outs (3 As + 3 Ks), heavily discounted because villain's turn-raise value combos contain JJ/77/55 sets (where overcards are pure misses), AJ/KJ/QJ (where A-high gives chop-or-worse, K gives nothing), and J7s/J5s/75s two-pair (overcards dead). Effective clean outs ≈ 4. Raw equity ≈ 9-12% vs value-heavy raise range. Pot odds: 18 to call into 46 pot = 39% required. Equity falls catastrophically short with no implied-odds bridge (no nut-flush river to extract on). SECOND: range-construction blocker direction. Multiway specialist's R1 argument is structurally correct independent of the board error. In MW BET_RAISE chains, the raiser's range is ~80-85% value because they must charge through TWO ranges. Bluff pool is small (~5-7 combos: A-high backdoor-FD combos, busted gutshot continuations, occasional combo-draw semi-bluffs). As-blocker removes ~1-2 bluff combos (proportionally large cut of small pool) and ~2-3 value combos (proportionally small cut of large pool). The residual conditional distribution becomes MORE value-heavy after blocking with As, not less. My R1 framing — that As-blocker removes 'protective NFD-A bluff-raises' — was wrong in two ways: (a) NFD doesn't exist on this turn so there are no NFD-A bluff-raises to remove; (b) even if it did, value-heavy raise ranges suffer more proportional cuts to their bluff sliver than to their value bulk when conditioning on a key value-blocker. THIRD: realisation. OOP-early in MW chain BET_RAISE, third villain still potentially live (or just folded), SPR collapses post-call to ~1.5 — hero is committed for river OOP into a value-heavy range with no draw. Realisation factor ≈ 0.7-0.8, further pulling effective equity below the call threshold. RAISE is dominated (no fold equity vs value-condensed range, turns A-high into a pure bluff). FOLD is range-construction-correct. Reversing from CALL MED to FOLD HIGH — significant change driven by board correction plus accepting Multiway peer's blocker-direction argument as structurally sound.
